As we've talked with teams across Northpointe, we've seen a common challenge.
Requests are often living in shared Outlook mailboxes.
Employees are searching through email threads. Forwarding messages. CC'ing multiple colleagues.
Trying to figure out who owns something.
Looking back through a long chain to figure out what the actual question was.
And when a team member is out of the office, it can become even harder to know where something stands or what has already been done.
The result can be extra back-and-forth, longer wait times, and a lot of work happening behind the scenes just to keep track of the work itself.
BoldDesk changes that by turning those emails into trackable work.
Instead of a request getting buried in an inbox, it becomes a ticket with an owner, a status, a history, and all of the information related to that request in one place.
